action:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production dark fantasy game UI sprite atlas, no text or icons. Generate a precise contact sheet on transparent background, 1536 wide by 3072 high. Exactly 3 columns and 9 rows of EQUALLY SIZED cells. Each cell contains one square button frame centered in its cell; no other objects. Square frame occupies 80% of cell width and 80% of cell height (each cell is 512x341, so frame MUST be square 274x274 pixels, centered). All squares share exactly same size, shape, placement and silhouette. The three columns are interaction states: idle, hover, pressed. Idle: dark oxidized metal with delicate luminous edge; hover: brighter energized inset engraving and highlighted bevel; pressed: recessed darker inner bevel with concentrated rim light. Keep center VERY DARK and completely empty and smooth, reserved for existing user icons and text. Corners narrowly chamfered, almost square, NO rounded app buttons. Refined thin crafted metal double bevel about 7% of width, tiny gem clasp at top middle, restrained fine corner engraving matching delicate fantasy card border flourishes. No large exterior spikes, no center symbols, no text, no letters, no UI labels, no shadows outside square.
The 9 rows top to bottom are different materials and motifs:
1 Forged Iron: graphite hammered steel, muted bronze rivets and warm silver engraving.
2 Infernal: charred iron, ember orange fissures only in the frame.
3 Glacial: blue steel, fine icy crystalline pale cyan rim.
4 Celestial: antique pale gold, delicate wing-like corner engraving.
5 Lunar Spectral: moon silver, pale lavender crescent engraving on corners.
6 Runic Arcane: blue-violet metal, tiny abstract arcane etchings on rim.
7 Tempest Oceanic: weathered teal steel, wave-like corner scrollwork.
8 Verdant: dark bronze, jade-green leaf filigree in corners.
9 Voidborn: obsidian, amethyst purple fine fractured rim.
Restrained premium painterly 2.5D RPG inventory UI artwork, sharp readable at 112x112 in game. All rows consistent perimeter thickness. Each state differs visibly through its metal lighting and engraving energy, but never changes size. Flat orthographic front view, no perspective. Transparent margins and gaps, no checkerboard baked into image.
navigation: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: companion button sprite atlas for the attached square RPG button frames. Generate an atlas of exactly 3 columns and 9 equally spaced rows. Each cell holds ONE SMALL HORIZONTAL RECTANGULAR EMPTY BUTTON PLATE, aspect ratio 1.45:1, centered, all exact same size across states and themes. Overall sheet portrait 1024x1792. Three columns idle, hover illuminated, pressed recessed dark. Each rectangle empty smooth nearly black center, restrained thin double bevel with clipped corners and delicate corner etching. NO arrow glyphs, NO icons, NO text: existing glyphs will be overlaid by code. These are navigation buttons used at 48x34 pixels below action buttons. Use the attached reference's exact material vocabulary, much simpler ornament appropriate to small size. Rows top to bottom: graphite forged iron with bronze studs; ember orange charred infernal iron; icy pale cyan blue steel; celestial pale gold; lunar silver and pale lavender; runic arcane blue violet; tempest oceanic teal wave scrollwork; verdant dark bronze jade leaf engraving; voidborn obsidian amethyst. State geometry identical. Idle softly lit, hover brighter bevel and energized engraving, pressed recessed dark face with fine lit rim. No protruding ornaments. Transparent background with generous clean gutters. Precise flat orthographic front view, no perspective. Entire 9 rows visible and separated, no annotations.
